title: DISSONANCE
description: A horror modpack filled with monsters and entities
body:
### Features all your favorite entities:
- Herobrine
- Playmate
- The Knocker
- The Man from the Fog (also known as Cave Dweller)

**Recommended to play with the provided Insanity Shader featured in the modpack!**

For the best experience play:
- **alone at night**
- with **lights off**
- with **high volume**.

You can play with your friends too
